preseason_hypothesis: Baltimore installs a multiple, disguise-oriented coverage identity with situational pressure
confirming_evidence: varied coverage shells; simulated and situational pressure

preseason_hypothesis: Hendrickson delivers premier edge production as the front's centerpiece
confirming_evidence: regular first-unit snaps; pressures and sacks; stays healthy
disconfirming_evidence: injury or reduced production; pressure depends on scheme help

preseason_hypothesis: A productive second edge and interior rotation emerges around Hendrickson
confirming_evidence: rotation produces pressure without heavy blitzing
disconfirming_evidence: pressure concentrated on Hendrickson only; thin rotation

preseason_hypothesis: Hamilton's alignment defines his IDP profile and the coverage structure
confirming_evidence: clear box or deep usage; splash plays and tackles
disconfirming_evidence: rotating role obscures his statistical profile

preseason_hypothesis: Baltimore settles the starting safety spot next to Hamilton after Gilman's departure
confirming_evidence: a clear starter emerges (Hawkins or another)
disconfirming_evidence: rotating safety through the preseason and season
